text:
Alex G: Heads-up — ACME Inc lead conflict. SI partner Nimbus submitted an intake last Thurs and marked as engaged; our field AE demoed yesterday and marked the account as 'in pipeline'. Nimbus says they own it. Can partnerships confirm the post-demo ownership rule? @Sana K :eyes:

Sana K: I pulled both records. Current informal practice is messy. Propose a clear, short rule: SI keeps ownership if they have scheduled a technical intro or an agreed POC/SOW before the AE demo. Otherwise the field owns after demo. This keeps it predictable.

Liam S: +1 on predictability. Edge-case: if SI has done design work or has signed SOW/NDA, they should keep it. We need a way to surface that evidence in Salesforce — otherwise it's just verbal.

Emily R: We can add a lightweight metadata flag and a workflow. Suggest adding checkbox(s) like `SI_claim_evidence` and `SI_has_poc` plus a workflow that blocks AE conversion/ownership change without a partnership approval tag. Ops can enforce.

Sam D: From SDR ops: please keep the flow short. SDRs need a 1-pager and a single email template for SI intro -> field transfer so we don't duplicate outreach.

Sana K: Agreed. Also proposing a 72-hour claim window after the demo: SI must submit claim evidence within 72 hours or ownership auto-transfers to field. Draft policy (example config):
```
si_claim_policy:
  evidence_required: ["scheduled_poc", "signed_sow", "technical_intro_cal_event"]
  claim_window_hours: 72
  transfer_policy: "auto-transfer-to-field"
```

Alex G: That seems reasonable. Sana — can you draft the one-pager + template? Emily — can you add the SFDC fields/workflow as a short ticket? I'll schedule a 15m sync to finalize.

ops-bot: Reminder: meeting created 2026-05-01 15:00 UTC — "SI claim resolution sync"

Sana K: I'll post the draft in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

Emily R: Ticket created: #OPS-1419 — will attach mock screenshots and test plan.

Liam S: Thanks — this will save us duplicated demos and emails.

Sam D: I'll prep the SDR template once Sana posts the draft.

Alex G: Awesome, thanks all. :thumbsup:
